runs.command:
BMKG_REF=$(curl -sS -H "X-BMKG-Key: $BMKG_API_KEY" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8281/seismic-events | jq -r '.[0].event_id')
curl -sS -H "X-BMKG-Key: $BMKG_API_KEY" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8281/seismic-events \
  | jq --arg id "$BMKG_REF" '.[] | select(.event_id == $id)'

curl -sS -H "X-Internal-Key: $AGGREGATOR_API_KEY" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8283/internal/v1/hazards?source=BMKG&view=full&limit=100' \
  | jq --arg id "$BMKG_REF" '.data[] | select(.source_ref_id == $id)'

PVMBG_REF=$(curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/volcanic-reports | jq -r '.[0].report_id')
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/volcanic-reports \
  | jq --arg id "$PVMBG_REF" '.[] | select(.report_id == $id)'

curl -sS -H "X-Internal-Key: $AGGREGATOR_API_KEY" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8283/internal/v1/hazards?source=PVMBG&view=full&limit=100' \
  | jq --arg id "$PVMBG_REF" '.data[] | select(.source_ref_id == $id)'

docker inspect $(docker compose ps -q) \
  | jq -S 'sort_by(.Name) | map({name: .Name, id: .Id,
      started_at: .State.StartedAt, restarts: .RestartCount})' > /tmp/report-session/schema-before.json
docker compose exec -T aggregator /aggregator store-audit \
  | jq '[.migrations[].version]'
curl -sS --fail-with-body \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"version":2}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/admin/schema-version | jq .
sleep 10

docker compose exec -T aggregator /aggregator history-audit \
  --source PVMBG --source-ref-id "$PVMBG_REF" --revisions 1,2 \
  | tee docs/report/evidence/schema-command-audit.json \
  | jq '{hazard_id, source_ref_id,
      versions: [.versions[] | {revision, attributes: .data.attributes}],
      migrations: [.migrations[].version]}'

docker inspect $(docker compose ps -q) \
  | jq -S 'sort_by(.Name) | map({name: .Name, id: .Id,
      started_at: .State.StartedAt, restarts: .RestartCount})' > /tmp/report-session/schema-after.json
diff -s /tmp/report-session/schema-before.json \
  /tmp/report-session/schema-after.json

curl -sS --fail-with-body \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data "{\"client_id\":\"field-team\",\"client_secret\":\"$FIELD_TEAM_CLIENT_SECRET\"}" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8284/v1/auth/login -o /tmp/report-session/field-team.json
jq '{token_type, expires_in, scope}' /tmp/report-session/field-team.json

curl -sS --fail-with-body \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data "{\"client_id\":\"media\",\"client_secret\":\"$MEDIA_CLIENT_SECRET\"}" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8284/v1/auth/login -o /tmp/report-session/media.json
jq '{token_type, expires_in, scope}' /tmp/report-session/media.json

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "X-BMKG-Key: $BMKG_API_KEY" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8281/seismic-events

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "X-BMKG-Key: $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8281/seismic-events

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/volcanic-reports

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BMKG_API_KEY" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/volcanic-reports

MEDIA_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(jq -r .access_token /tmp/report-session/media.json)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $MEDIA_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?source=BMKG&limit=1' \
  | jq '.data[0] | keys'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MEDIA_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?view=full'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MEDIA_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?fields=attributes'

curl -sS --fail-with-body \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"min_ms":3000,"max_ms":3000}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/admin/delay | jq .
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}; durasi %{time_total} s\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/volcanic-reports

curl -sS --fail-with-body \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"enabled":true}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/admin/outage | jq .
sleep 10

FIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(jq -r .access_token /tmp/report-session/field-team.json)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?source=PVMBG&view=full&limit=5' \
  | jq '{records: (.data | length), source: .meta.sources.PVMBG}'
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?source=BMKG&view=full&limit=1' \
  | jq '.meta.sources.BMKG'

curl -sS --fail-with-body \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PVMBG_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"enabled":false}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:8282/admin/outage | jq .
sleep 10
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?source=PVMBG&view=full&limit=1' \
  | jq '.meta.sources.PVMBG'

curl -sS --fail-with-body \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data "{\"client_id\":\"field-team\",\"client_secret\":\"$FIELD_TEAM_CLIENT_SECRET\"}" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8284/v1/auth/login -o /tmp/report-session/field-team.json
jq '{token_type, expires_in, scope}' /tmp/report-session/field-team.json

FIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(jq -r .access_token /tmp/report-session/field-team.json)
jq -r .access_token /tmp/report-session/field-team.json \
  | jq -R 'split(".")[1] | @base64d | fromjson | {iat, exp, ttl: (.exp-.iat)}'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?source=BMKG&view=full&limit=1'

docker inspect $(docker compose ps -q) \
  | jq -S 'map(select(.Config.Labels["com.docker.compose.service"]
      != "dashboard-consumer")) | sort_by(.Name)
      | map({name: .Name, id: .Id, started_at: .State.StartedAt,
          restarts: .RestartCount})' > /tmp/report-session/rebuild-before.json
docker compose stop dashboard-consumer
docker compose build dashboard-consumer \
  > /tmp/report-session/rebuild.log 2>&1
tail -n 6 /tmp/report-session/rebuild.log
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  'http://127.0.0.1:8280/v1/hazards?source=BMKG&view=full&limit=1'
docker compose up -d --no-deps --force-recreate --wait dashboard-consumer
